capabilities: Convert Chinese ordinal punctuation to standard Markdown ordered markers on space
Create bullet or task children by typing - or [ on the line after an ordered item
Demote and promote list items with Tab and Shift+Tab while keeping child types consistent
Delete a whole list marker with Backspace while keeping the content
extras: README is bilingual (English and Chinese); the manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff.
problem: Chinese ordinal punctuation like 1、 does not produce valid Markdown lists, and changing list types or demoting items while typing requires manual marker edits.
summary: List input helper that converts Chinese punctuation to standard Markdown numbering and switches ordered, bullet, and task lists with keystrokes.
